epics.title: System Containerization and Deployment
epics.jtbd: When running the product locally, I want to start the full stack with a single command, so that I can verify its real-world behavior and observability.
requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml file at the repository root to start the full stack.
R2: Expose a health-check endpoint that can be verified.

slices.title: Add Docker Compose configuration
slices.jtbd: When implementing full stack containerization for this epic, I want to configure a docker-compose.yml file, so that the entire product stack and health-check endpoint can be started locally with a single command.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository root, When I run docker-compose up, Then the backend, frontend, and database start successfully.
Given the running stack, When an integration test queries the health-check endpoint, Then it returns a 200 OK status to verify the real-world deployment.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce local environment setup time from >10 minutes to <1 minute

epics.title: Epidemiological Material Cataloging and Management
epics.jtbd: When I manage the epidemiology knowledge base, I want to catalog and update materials, so that the information is structured and up to date.
requirements: R1: Provide a UI action to update existing epidemiological materials.
R2: Provide a UI action to delete existing epidemiological materials.

slices.title: Implement UI for updating and deleting materials
slices.jtbd: When implementing material management UI for this epic, I want to add update and delete actions, so that users can manage existing materials directly from the interface.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the system, When a user chooses to edit or delete it from the UI, Then the frontend invokes the corresponding PUT or DELETE API endpoint.
Given the new UI components, When frontend unit tests are run, Then component rendering and state logic are verified.
Given the integrated UI, When E2E tests are executed, Then the critical user journey for updating and deleting materials is successfully validated.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce time to update or delete materials from >5 minutes to <30 seconds

epics.title: Authentication and Authorization Mechanism
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthorized access incidents from >0 to 0
requirements: R1: Block unauthenticated users from accessing the catalog or creating a material.
R2: Prompt unauthenticated users to log in when access is blocked.

slices.title: Enforce authentication and authorization
slices.jtbd: When implementing the authorization mechanism for this epic, I want to enforce access controls on existing routes, so that unauthenticated users are blocked and prompted to log in.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to access restricted catalog endpoints, Then they are blocked from accessing the resource and prompted to log in.
Given the authentication logic, When unit tests are run, Then authorization rules and blocked state logic are verified.
Given the API layer, When integration tests are executed, Then access control enforcement on the endpoints is strictly validated.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Ensure 100% of restricted endpoints require authentication compared to 0%
